item.title: Another apparel brand is closing its retail stores. It was once a tech bro favorite
item.description: Allbirds shoe brand announced on Wednesday that it will close almost all of its U.S. stores by the end of February (except for two outlets) and go online, turning to e-commerce instead. It will continue to operate two London-based brick-and-mortar locations as well. item.title: Tim Cook calls for de-escalation but avoids criticizing Trump after Minneapolis death
item.description: President Trump is facing a rare bipartisan backlash after a group of federal agents shot and killed protester Alex Pretti in Minneapolis on Saturday. But tech industry leaders—once some of Trump’s fiercest critics—are sitting this one out. item.title: Why predictable AI will finally fix customer experience
item.description: For years, the customer experience playbook has been treated like a technology problem. Add another tool. Deploy another bot. Automate another workflow. And yet here we are, heading into 2026 with customer satisfaction in freefall. Forrester’s 2025 CX Index shows scores hitting a new low for the fourth consecutive year. item.title: Meta stock price soars on strong Q4 ad sales. Spending on AI is way up, too
item.description: Meta’s fourth-quarter results jumped past Wall Street’s expectations thanks to solid advertising revenue, sending shares sharply higher in after-hours trading Wednesday. The company earned $22.77 billion, or $8.88 per share, in the October-December quarter. That’s up 9% from $20.84 billion, or $8.02 per share, in the same period a year earlier. item.title: The world’s best talent has stopped dreaming of America. Where will it go next?
item.description: For a generation, the smartest people I knew dreamed of moving to America. They took uninspiring jobs, learned to wait through endless paperwork, and believed that one visa stamp could change their lives. That belief built an empire of talent that powered some of the world’s most iconic companies. And now, that same empire is dying, or at the very least, dreaming of moving elsewhere.
